subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform job tags, typed purpose/display metadata, or a narrower plugin/reminder scheduling contract?
rationale: The request changes durable cron schema, protocol/API filtering, UI presentation, CLI output, and plugin/reminder behavior, and the related metadata PR was explicitly closed pending owner-reviewed API design.

options.title: Shared typed classification/display contract
options.body: Add an additive cron purpose/display metadata model that can support tags, reminders, plugins, API filters, UI display, and future bulk operations without payload parsing or name-prefix conventions.

options.title: Freeform tags API
options.body: Implement the requested tags array directly and accept that reminders or plugin scheduling may need a second typed display layer later.

options.title: Defer to narrower surfaces
options.body: Keep general cron tags out of core for now and only design the narrower reminder/plugin scheduling classification contract first.

recommendation.title: Shared typed classification/display contract
recommendation.body: Add an additive cron purpose/display metadata model that can support tags, reminders, plugins, API filters, UI display, and future bulk operations without payload parsing or name-prefix conventions.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest prior maintainer signal on the related cron metadata/API direction and has recent cron runtime history.
